name: MT-LB
protection: Light armour. Game: immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R AP and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable wheels/engine; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Very low flat-topped tracked hull (about 1.9 m tall) with a box-shaped crew cab at the front
6 large road wheels per side, no return rollers, wide tracks (snow-capable)
Small one-man conical MG turret on the front-right of the roof
Two large rear doors and two roof hatches over the troop space
Finnish vehicles often in white winter wash or three-tone green
Flat tracked hull, 6 road wheels, small MG turret
Russian 2026 field look: improvised anti-drone cage/roof shed over the troop compartment, mesh netting, often towing guns or mounting ZU-23-2 on the roof
